auditFindings.details: Path traversal checked with os.path.exists; extension validated for .pdf; pypdf parser exceptions handled gracefully.
Strict prompt boundary delimiters (--- CONTEXT --- / --- QUESTION --- / --- ANSWER ---) prevent instruction tampering.
Zero hardcoded credentials or API tokens found. Environment variables GEMINI_API_KEY and OPENAI_API_KEY are accessed dynamically.
Embeddings and documents are stored locally in ChromaDB without leaking to third-party endpoints unless explicitly configured by user.
